headline: Agreed to send a letter of support for Governor Healey's FY27 supplemental budget bill, under which the district would receive $300,000 to $330,000.
summary: Governor Healey's FY27 supplemental budget is $100 million, with an average increase of $112 per student. The superintendent said the district would receive one-time Fair Share Act money of $300,000 to $330,000. Members agreed to send a letter of support, and the chairperson will circulate a draft first.
decisions: Agreed to send a letter of support for Governor Healey's FY27 supplemental appropriation bill.
Approved entering executive session under MGL 30A, Section 21(a), Purpose 1, by roll call vote of 7-0.

THE GLOUCESTER PUBLIC SCHOOLS 
Our mission is for all students to be successful, engaged, lifelong learners. 
Special School Committee Meeting Minutes - Remote Only 
Monday, July 20, 2026 
Gloucester High School Library and via Zoom 
32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930 
5:00 p.m. 
Members Present  Administration Present 
Kathleen Clancy, Chairperson Amy Pasquarello, Superintendent 
William Melvin, Vice Chairperson 
Laura Wiessen, Secretary 
Heather Dagle 
Andrea Liacos  
Paul Lundberg, Mayor 
Melissa Prince  
This meeting was conducted with the School Committee remote only 
and the public participating remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER – Chairperson Clancy called the meeting to order at 5:02 p.m. and
stated the mission of the Gloucester Public Schools.
II. DELIBERATION ON EDUCATIONAL ISSUES
A. Governor Healey’s Bill “An Act Making Appropriations for Fiscal Year 2027
(FY27) to provide for Supplementing Certain Existing Appropriations and
for Certain other Activities and Projects”
Superintendent Pasquarello presented and the Committee discussed that Governor
Healey released a press release that there will be a $100 million supplemental
budget, which will raise an average increase of $112 per student.  She stated that
this money would be coming to our district as a one-time Fair Share Act money,
which means that the Gloucester Public Schools would receive between $300,000
to $330,000 extra dollars.
